O que é dado pessoal e sensível: What counts as personal and sensitive data
Dado pessoal é o que identifica ou pode: Personal data is anything that identifies or can identify a person. Sensitive data includes health, racial origin, religious belief, political opinion, biometrics and genetics.
Conversa de atendimento quase sempre tem: A customer service conversation almost always contains personal data: name, phone, address.
Todo tratamento precisa de uma base lega: Every processing activity needs a legal basis: consent, contract performance, legal obligation, legitimate interest, among others. Sensitive data has narrower rules (art. 11).

Mandar dado pessoal para um servidor for: Sending personal data to a server outside Brazil is an international transfer and is only allowed in specific cases, such as contract clauses approved by the ANPD (Brazil's data protection authority).
Usar uma API hospedada nos EUA ou na Chi: Using an API hosted in the US or China with customer data falls under this.
O titular pode pedir revisão de decisão: Data subjects can request a review of a decision made solely by automated means that affects their interests (art. 20), such as a credit denial.
A empresa precisa de medidas de seguranç: The company needs security measures to protect the data (art. 46): an exposed key and an open spreadsheet are the opposite of that.
